title: Repositories of the person's Gitea connections
description: GET /api/v1/integrations/gitea/repos takes no query. The mapped daemon reads each usable tea login's /user/repos with that login's own token, page by page within a time, page and result bound. Each connection is its own source with its own state: one source failing never empties another, and a failed source is never an empty success. Before listing, the token must still authenticate the account tea's entry names (account_mismatch otherwise). complete is true only when a page came back empty before the bound and the pages agreed with each other; a short page alone does not end the list, and a rejection or missing scope on any page fails the source. Pagination links are checked against the base, never followed. A repository is identified by its source's connection_id and Gitea's own id, never by owner/name alone; the same owner/name on another base is another repository, and one repository seen by two accounts is listed by each source.

incomplete.description: Why an ok source is not complete: limit (a page, result or byte bound, or the reply's bound across sources, was reached), interrupted (a later page failed or the time bound ran out), inconsistent (the pages disagreed: a repeated repository, a changed total, a link outside the list, or a repository whose address is not under the base).

size_kib.description: Gitea's own repository size in KiB.

empty.description: Gitea says the repository has no commits; such a repository cannot be cloned as a workspace yet.

owned.description: Gitea's owner id is the id of the account the token authenticates. Gitea does not say whether another owner is an organisation or a person the account collaborates with without a scope beyond read:repository, so the rest are simply not the account's own.
